_comment: cloud-ci-capability-membership gate policy (DATA, not code). Phase-0 capability-first reorg (ADR-0562 §6, the anti-junk-drawer MEMBERSHIP lint — the closed-registry enforcement that makes capability-first safe). The CLOSED capability set + the per-crate mappings + the frozen-unmapped baseline are the single source of truth in governance/capability-registry.json; this policy holds only the gate identity, the registry pointer, the crate-scan roots, the closed meta-directory set, the closed-set top-level-dir whitelist, and the live-corpus crate floor. Born ADVISORY with a frozen baseline: the gate enforces NO REGRESSION (no NEW unmapped crate, no NEW top-level dir outside the closed set) and burns the unmapped baseline DOWN as the strangler homes crates; it flips to BLOCKING when the frozen baseline reaches 0. Born pack-shaped: an adopting repo repoints registry_path + scan_roots + meta_directories; the Rust kernel hardcodes no oyatie path nor any capability slug. SCAN COVERAGE IS DERIVED, NOT HAND-KEPT: `scan_roots` must carry every capability top-level root AND every registry meta directory with owns_crates=true (kernel/os/base/app) — the cross-artifact-agreement registry⇄derived-policy sync check re-derives that requirement from governance/capability-registry.json and REDs on any root dropped here, so a destination root can never fall out of lint coverage silently (a crate-owning root outside `scan_roots` is invisible to the membership lint, and the min_expected_crates floor is a broken-scan guard, NOT a coverage guard).

legacy_root_freeze._comment: STOP ACCRUAL (ADR-0562 §6 strangler). The legacy source roots are FROZEN SHRINK-ONLY. Every crate dir that lived under a `frozen_roots` entry at the freeze commit is listed in `crates` and is tolerated forever; a crate dir under a frozen root that is NOT listed is a crate BORN into a root the reorg exists to empty, and fails MEM-NEW-LEGACY-ROOT-CRATE. Removing a name is burn-down and is always allowed — it is also REQUIRED: a listed dir that is no longer a crate fires MEM-STALE-LEGACY-ROOT-BASELINE, so the census shrinks in lockstep with the moves and slack cannot outlive the debt it was granted for (the same contract crate-catalog-coverage's `uncatalogued` carries). PRODUCER-EMITTED, NEVER HAND-TYPED: `buck2 run //ci/facade/module-membership:cloud-ci-capability-membership-app-bin -- --repo-root . --emit-legacy-freeze` prints this whole block from the gate's OWN collect(), so the census can never drift from the corpus the gate actually walks; the producer REFUSES to grow the census without --allow-new, so a regen cannot launder a newly-born legacy-root crate into the tolerated set. `frozen_roots` is deliberately NOT spelled `roots`/`scan_roots`: it is not coverage-bearing (an emptied frozen root does not go vacuous, it goes maximally strict — every crate born there is new), so it is correctly outside cloud-ci-scan-root-liveness scope and carries no anti-narrowing debt when a drained root is finally retired. Burned 24 cloud/** rows same-change with the founder dev push c2ee2631a "Delete cloud directory" (clean slate; kuberos/k8s regenerate via port engine).

_provenance.policy: shrink-only; a NEW crate under a frozen root belongs in its capability root instead
